name: Moeben ~Itoko wa Fusumagoshi~
original_name: もえべん ～いとこ(妹)はふすまごし～
source:
Main character comes to work at a bento shop. He stays at a residence where shop workers live together with his cousin and several cute girls. Young people repeat naughty act every night and enjoy their youth.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-may-2003-ashita-deatta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公来到一家便当店工作，并住进了店员共同生活的宿舍，与表妹及几名可爱的少女朝夕相处。年轻人夜夜亲热胡闹，尽情享受着自己的青春。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-may-2003-ashita-deatta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
